questions.question_text: Describe the leadership qualities demonstrated by Major Somnath Sharma during the Battle of Badgam.
questions.correct_answer: Major Somnath Sharma demonstrated extraordinary courage, duty, and selflessness. Despite a broken arm, he refused relief and volunteered for the front. Facing 500 enemy raiders with only 90 men, he personally refilled ammunition magazines, laid out air markers, and directed fire. His final refusal to retreat delayed the enemy until reinforcements arrived, exemplifying highest patriotic devotion.
